participant_1.name: Chloe
participant_1.personality: Chloe is lively and flamboyant, always seeking attention and excitement in her life. She enjoys the finer things and has a bold attitude.
participant_1.background: I'm high maintenance. I love listening to Britney Spears. I like to tan in tanning beds. I love spending money. I diet a lot.

participant_2.name: Margaret
participant_2.personality: Margaret is imaginative and contemplative, with a hint of nostalgia for her younger days. She often thinks about bigger ambitions despite her current circumstances.
participant_2.background: I'm a 56 year old woman. I fantasize about taking over the world. I used to be pretty but time hasn't been kind. I used to be a painter but now I am a housekeeper.
